# DataXAPI: every endpoint

> 207 endpoints, one line each: the name (linked to the whole contract), the request, the price, what comes back. Base URL `https://api.dataxapi.com`. How to call, pay and handle errors is the same everywhere: https://dataxapi.com/llms.txt

Generated from catalog revision c48ce454ae6c4c65, price book 2.

## Douyin

- [Douyin comment replies](https://dataxapi.com/apis/douyin/comments/replies/list.md) `GET /v1/douyin/comments/replies/list` $0.002 per call, also when the result is empty. Get a page of the replies under a Douyin comment, by the comment's ID and its video's ID: text, replier, likes, time posted.
- [Douyin hashtag videos](https://dataxapi.com/apis/douyin/hashtags/videos/list.md) `GET /v1/douyin/hashtags/videos/list` $0.002 per call, also when the result is empty. Get a page of Douyin videos under a hashtag, by the hashtag's ID: caption, author, engagement counts, time posted.
- [Douyin trend-index brand trends](https://dataxapi.com/apis/douyin/index/brands/history.md) `GET /v1/douyin/index/brands/history` $0.002 per call, nothing when it finds nothing. Get a brand's day-by-day search, content and spread indexes on Douyin over a date range, from the platform's own index tool. An index is the platform's score, not a count; days are calendar days in China time (UTC+8).
- [Douyin trend-index brand comparison](https://dataxapi.com/apis/douyin/index/brands/metrics.md) `GET /v1/douyin/index/brands/metrics` $0.002 per call, nothing when it finds nothing. Get the daily averages of a brand's search, content and spread indexes on Douyin over a date range, from the platform's own index tool, with the averages of every brand in its industry and of the industry's top 3, 5, 10, 15 and 30 to hold them against. An index is the platform's score, not a count.
- [Douyin trend-index creator top videos](https://dataxapi.com/apis/douyin/index/creators/videos/list.md) `GET /v1/douyin/index/creators/videos/list` $0.002 per call, also when the result is empty. Get the videos the platform's own index tool lists as a Douyin account's top videos for a span of up to 30 days, by the account's numeric ID: up to twenty, most liked first, each with caption, link, day published, its engagement counts and followers gained. As recorded, the tool picks from what was published on the last day or two of the span, not from all of it: set the end date to the day you want. One page; no view counts.
- [Douyin trend-index creator follower profile](https://dataxapi.com/apis/douyin/index/creators/audience/get.md) `GET /v1/douyin/index/creators/audience/get` $0.002 per call, nothing when it finds nothing. Get who follows a Douyin account from the platform's own index tool, by the account's numeric ID: the share of each segment by gender, age, province, city, city tier, phone brand and interest. Not limited to marketplace creators; shares only, no head counts.
- [Douyin trend-index creator core metrics](https://dataxapi.com/apis/douyin/index/creators/metrics.md) `GET /v1/douyin/index/creators/metrics` $0.002 per call, nothing when it finds nothing. Get a Douyin creator's core figures from the platform's own index tool, by the account's numeric ID: new likes, followers, shares and comments a day on average over the last week and the last month, each as a ratio against the period before. An account the tool has nothing on (every figure 0) is answered as not found.
- [Douyin trend-index keyword audience](https://dataxapi.com/apis/douyin/index/keywords/audience/get.md) `GET /v1/douyin/index/keywords/audience/get` $0.002 per call, nothing when it finds nothing. Get who is behind a keyword on Douyin over a date range, from the platform's own keyword tool: the share and TGI of each age group, gender, province, city, city tier and interest.
- [Douyin trend-index keyword trends](https://dataxapi.com/apis/douyin/index/keywords/history.md) `GET|POST /v1/douyin/index/keywords/history` $0.006 per call, also when the result is empty. Get the day-by-day search index and composite index of a keyword, or of one to five keywords at once, on Douyin over a date range, from 巨量算数 (the Douyin index), with the daily averages of the period, of the one before and of a year earlier. An index is the platform's score of volume, not a count of searches; days are calendar days in China time (UTC+8).
- [Douyin trend-index related keywords](https://dataxapi.com/apis/douyin/index/keywords/related.md) `GET /v1/douyin/index/keywords/related` $0.002 per call, also when the result is empty. Get the keywords related to a keyword on Douyin in one week, from the platform's own keyword tool: those searched together with it and those that appear with it in content, each with its relevance, its place by relevance, its search index and its composite index. An index is the platform's score of volume, not a count of searches.
- [Douyin trend-index live hot topics](https://dataxapi.com/apis/douyin/index/trends/list.md) `GET /v1/douyin/index/trends/list` $0.002 per call, also when the result is empty. Get the live topic board or the fastest-rising topic board of Douyin's index tool, about 30 entries each: place, name, topic index, number of related videos, their plays and a category. The topic index is the platform's score of heat, not a count of searches.
- [Douyin trend-index keyword hot videos](https://dataxapi.com/apis/douyin/index/videos/search.md) `GET /v1/douyin/index/videos/search` $0.002 per call, also when the result is empty. Get the roughly 20 high-index videos Douyin's index tool puts forward for a keyword: caption, link, author's display name, likes, video index and category. One page only; the author's ID and the publication time are not given, the video endpoint has them.
- [Douyin hot search board](https://dataxapi.com/apis/douyin/trends/list.md) `GET /v1/douyin/trends/list` $0.002 per call, also when the result is empty. Get a Douyin hot list: hot searches, rising topics, topic ranking, top search terms or the music chart, with rank and heat.
- [Douyin user profile](https://dataxapi.com/apis/douyin/users/get.md) `GET /v1/douyin/users/get` $0.002 per call, nothing when it finds nothing. Get a Douyin user's profile by account ID or profile link: name, handle, bio, follower, following and post counts, total likes, verification.
- [Douyin creator engagement and follower trends](https://dataxapi.com/apis/douyin/users/history.md) `GET|POST /v1/douyin/users/history` $0.002 per call, nothing when it finds nothing. Get how a Douyin account's numbers moved over the last 7 or 30 days, by its numeric ID, from the platform's own index tool: net new followers, new likes, comments, shares and posts, each as a ratio against the period before, and the totals now; up to five accounts in one request. It is one period's sum, not a day-by-day series.
- [Douyin user search](https://dataxapi.com/apis/douyin/users/search.md) `GET /v1/douyin/users/search` $0.002 per call, also when the result is empty. Search Douyin accounts by terms, a page at a time: account ID, display name, avatar, follower count, post count, total likes.
- [Douyin user videos](https://dataxapi.com/apis/douyin/users/videos/list.md) `GET /v1/douyin/users/videos/list` $0.002 per call, also when the result is empty. Get a page of the videos a Douyin account has posted, newest first: caption, engagement counts, time posted.
- [Douyin video comments](https://dataxapi.com/apis/douyin/videos/comments/list.md) `GET /v1/douyin/videos/comments/list` $0.002 per call, also when the result is empty. Get a page of comments on a Douyin video: text, commenter, likes, reply count, time posted.
- [Douyin video detail](https://dataxapi.com/apis/douyin/videos/get.md) `GET /v1/douyin/videos/get` $0.002 per call, nothing when it finds nothing. Get one Douyin video or image post by ID or link: caption, author, engagement counts, time posted.
- [Douyin video play count](https://dataxapi.com/apis/douyin/videos/metrics.md) `GET /v1/douyin/videos/metrics` $0.002 per call, nothing when it finds nothing. Get a Douyin video's counts as of now, by its ID: plays and likes.
- [Douyin related videos](https://dataxapi.com/apis/douyin/videos/related.md) `GET /v1/douyin/videos/related` $0.002 per call, also when the result is empty. Get the batch of videos Douyin recommends beside a video, by its ID: caption, author, engagement counts. The recommendations may differ from call to call.
- [Douyin video search](https://dataxapi.com/apis/douyin/videos/search.md) `GET /v1/douyin/videos/search` $0.02 per call, also when the result is empty. Search Douyin videos by terms, a page at a time, sorted by relevance, newest or most liked and filtered by time posted: caption, author with follower count, engagement counts.
- [Douyin trending videos](https://dataxapi.com/apis/douyin/videos/trending.md) `GET /v1/douyin/videos/trending` $0.002 per call, also when the result is empty. Get a Douyin video board for the last day: breakouts from small accounts, highest like rate, highest completion rate or highest follow rate, with plays, likes and the author's follower count.
- [Douyin Xingtu creator rate card](https://dataxapi.com/apis/douyin/xingtu/creators/rates/get.md) `GET /v1/douyin/xingtu/creators/rates/get` $0.04 per call, nothing when it finds nothing. Get what a Douyin creator charges on Xingtu for each kind of sponsored work, and how it is settled.
- [Douyin Xingtu creator search](https://dataxapi.com/apis/douyin/xingtu/creators/search.md) `GET /v1/douyin/xingtu/creators/search` $0.004 per call, also when the result is empty. Search Douyin creators on Xingtu by words in their name: Xingtu creator ID, name, location, content categories, followers, and in the full view what a video of each of two lengths costs and the views expected of one. The creator ID the other Xingtu endpoints take comes from here.
- [Douyin Xingtu creator profile](https://dataxapi.com/apis/douyin/xingtu/creators/get.md) `GET|POST /v1/douyin/xingtu/creators/get` $0.004 per call, nothing when it finds nothing. Get a Douyin creator's profile on Xingtu by Xingtu creator ID: name, location, content categories, followers; one ID also gives the Douyin account ID and handle, several IDs (up to 50) give what a video of each of two lengths costs and the views expected of one instead.
- [Douyin Xingtu creator audience](https://dataxapi.com/apis/douyin/xingtu/creators/audience/get.md) `GET /v1/douyin/xingtu/creators/audience/get` $0.004 per call, nothing when it finds nothing. Get who follows a Douyin creator, by Xingtu creator ID: followers and share in each segment by gender, age, province, city, city tier, interest, device, consumer group, purchase category and purchase amount.
- [Douyin Xingtu creator metrics](https://dataxapi.com/apis/douyin/xingtu/creators/metrics.md) `GET /v1/douyin/xingtu/creators/metrics` $0.004 per call, nothing when it finds nothing. Get how a Douyin creator's videos did over the last 30 or 90 days, by Xingtu creator ID: videos, median views, average likes, comments and shares, engagement and completion ratios, expected cost per thousand views and per interaction.
- [Douyin Xingtu creator video performance](https://dataxapi.com/apis/douyin/xingtu/creators/videos/list.md) `GET /v1/douyin/xingtu/creators/videos/list` $0.004 per call, also when the result is empty. Get a page of a Douyin creator's videos by Xingtu creator ID, newest first, with the figures Xingtu gives for each: views, likes, completion and engagement ratios, length.
- [Douyin Xingtu creator content keywords](https://dataxapi.com/apis/douyin/xingtu/creators/keywords/get.md) `GET /v1/douyin/xingtu/creators/keywords/get` $0.002 per call, nothing when it finds nothing. Get the words a Douyin creator's recent videos keep coming back to, by Xingtu creator ID: about twenty, each with how many times the marketplace counted it. It shows what the creator has been talking about lately; the counts are in single digits, so the data is thin.
- [Douyin Xingtu creator index scores](https://dataxapi.com/apis/douyin/xingtu/creators/scores/get.md) `GET /v1/douyin/xingtu/creators/scores/get` $0.008 per call, nothing when it finds nothing. Get the six scores Xingtu gives a Douyin creator, by Xingtu creator ID: the overall Xingtu score and those for reach, seeding, conversion, cooperation and value for money, each with the score, the average of comparable creators, the rank and how far from the top that rank is.
- [Douyin Xingtu creator content mix](https://dataxapi.com/apis/douyin/xingtu/creators/content_mix/get.md) `GET /v1/douyin/xingtu/creators/content_mix/get` $0.004 per call, nothing when it finds nothing. Get what a Douyin creator's recent videos are about, by Xingtu creator ID: the number of videos in each of the marketplace's content categories and their share. It shows whether the creator keeps to one subject.
- [Douyin Xingtu creator conversion](https://dataxapi.com/apis/douyin/xingtu/creators/conversion/get.md) `GET /v1/douyin/xingtu/creators/conversion/get` $0.004 per call, nothing when it finds nothing. Get how well a Douyin creator's product videos sell, by Xingtu creator ID: videos counted, their median views, products recommended, the bands that sales, sales per thousand views, product price, cost per click, product-link clicks and click rate fall in, and the categories of goods. A band is the platform's text, not an exact figure; a creator with no selling figures is answered as not found.
- [Douyin Xingtu marketing calendar](https://dataxapi.com/apis/douyin/xingtu/campaigns/list.md) `GET /v1/douyin/xingtu/campaigns/list` $0.004 per call, also when the result is empty. Get the campaigns on Xingtu's marketing calendar over a span of time: platform events, e-commerce and seasonal moments, creative and industry campaigns, each with its name, description, kind, stage, sign-up period and running period. All at once, no paging.

- [Bilibili comment replies](https://dataxapi.com/apis/bilibili/comments/replies/list.md) `GET /v1/bilibili/comments/replies/list` $0.002 per call, also when the result is empty. Get a page of replies to a Bilibili comment, by the comment's ID and its video's BV number: text, replier, likes, what it answers, time posted.

- [Bilibili user profile](https://dataxapi.com/apis/bilibili/users/get.md) `GET /v1/bilibili/users/get` $0.002 per call, nothing when it finds nothing. Get a Bilibili user's profile by user number: name, bio, avatar, verification, follower and following counts, number of videos.
- [Bilibili user videos](https://dataxapi.com/apis/bilibili/users/videos/list.md) `GET /v1/bilibili/users/videos/list` $0.002 per call, also when the result is empty. Get a page of the videos a Bilibili user uploaded, newest first: title, description, views, comments, danmaku count, length, time published.
- [Bilibili video comments](https://dataxapi.com/apis/bilibili/videos/comments/list.md) `GET /v1/bilibili/videos/comments/list` $0.002 per call, also when the result is empty. Get a page of comments on a Bilibili video by BV number, most liked first: text, commenter, likes, reply count, time posted.
- [Bilibili video detail](https://dataxapi.com/apis/bilibili/videos/get.md) `GET /v1/bilibili/videos/get` $0.002 per call, nothing when it finds nothing. Get one Bilibili video by BV number or link: title, description, uploader, views, likes, coins, saves, danmaku count, length.

Get a page of Bilibili videos for search terms, by relevance, newest or most played: title, uploader, views, likes, saves, comments, length.
- [Bilibili popular videos](https://dataxapi.com/apis/bilibili/videos/trending.md) `GET /v1/bilibili/videos/trending` $0.002 per call, also when the result is empty. Get a page of Bilibili's popular videos: title, description, uploader, views, likes, coins, saves, danmaku count, length.

With sort=popular: $0.002 per call, also when the result is empty. Get a page of the videos a Kuaishou account has posted, newest or most popular first: caption, play and engagement counts, time posted.

## Telegram

- [Telegram channel profile](https://dataxapi.com/apis/telegram/channels/get.md) `GET /v1/telegram/channels/get` $0.002 per call, nothing when it finds nothing. Get a public Telegram channel by its handle: name, description, subscriber count, verification.
- [Telegram channel messages](https://dataxapi.com/apis/telegram/channels/messages/list.md) `GET /v1/telegram/channels/messages/list` $0.002 per call, also when the result is empty. Get a page of a public Telegram channel's messages by its handle, newest first: text, time posted, views, images.
- [Telegram message detail](https://dataxapi.com/apis/telegram/messages/get.md) `GET /v1/telegram/messages/get` $0.002 per call, nothing when it finds nothing. Get one message of a public Telegram channel by channel handle and message number, or by its link: text, time posted, views, images.

## X (Twitter)

- [X community posts](https://dataxapi.com/apis/x/communities/posts/list.md) `GET /v1/x/communities/posts/list` $0.0003 per item returned, at least $0.0003 and at most $0.006 per call, $0.0003 when the result is empty. Get a page of the posts in an X community by the community's ID.
- [X list posts](https://dataxapi.com/apis/x/lists/posts/list.md) `GET /v1/x/lists/posts/list` $0.002 per call, also when the result is empty. Get a page of the posts on an X list's timeline by the list's ID, newest first, about 100 a page.
- [X article detail](https://dataxapi.com/apis/x/posts/article/get.md) `GET /v1/x/posts/article/get` $0.002 per call, nothing when it finds nothing. Get the long-form article attached to an X post by the post's ID: title, full text, author, time published, and its like, reply and view counts.
- [X post detail](https://dataxapi.com/apis/x/posts/get.md) `GET /v1/x/posts/get` $0.0003 per call, nothing when it finds nothing. Get one X post by ID or link: text, author, time posted, and its like, reply, retweet, quote, bookmark and view counts.
- [X post quotes](https://dataxapi.com/apis/x/posts/quotes/list.md) `GET /v1/x/posts/quotes/list` $0.0003 per item returned, at least $0.0003 and at most $0.006 per call, $0.0003 when the result is empty. With sort=popular: $0.002 per call, also when the result is empty. Get a page of the X posts that quote a post, newest first or most popular first.
- [X post replies](https://dataxapi.com/apis/x/posts/replies/list.md) `GET /v1/x/posts/replies/list` $0.002 per call, also when the result is empty. Get a page of the replies under an X post by its ID, in the platform's order of relevance; a reply on X is itself a post and is returned as one.
- [X post retweeters](https://dataxapi.com/apis/x/posts/retweeters/list.md) `GET /v1/x/posts/retweeters/list` $0.002 per call, also when the result is empty. Get a page of the accounts that retweeted an X post, by the post's ID: handle, name, bio, follower count.
- [X post search](https://dataxapi.com/apis/x/posts/search.md) `GET /v1/x/posts/search` $0.002 per call, also when the result is empty. Find X posts by search terms, most popular or newest first; the terms may use X's own search operators, such as from:handle.
- [X thread context](https://dataxapi.com/apis/x/threads/posts/list.md) `GET /v1/x/threads/posts/list` $0.0003 per item returned, at least $0.0003 and at most $0.015 per call, $0.0003 when the result is empty. Get the posts of an X thread by the ID of any post in it: the root post, the author's follow-ups and the replies among them.
- [X trends](https://dataxapi.com/apis/x/trends/list.md) `GET /v1/x/trends/list` $0.009 per call, nothing when it finds nothing. Get the top 30 of what is trending on X now, with rank: worldwide, or in one country.
- [X user followers](https://dataxapi.com/apis/x/users/followers/list.md) `GET /v1/x/users/followers/list` $0.0001 per item returned, at least $0.0004 and at most $0.02 per call, $0.0004 when the result is empty. Get a page of the accounts following an X user, up to 200 a page, newest followers first.
- [X user following](https://dataxapi.com/apis/x/users/following/list.md) `GET /v1/x/users/following/list` $0.0001 per item returned, at least $0.0004 and at most $0.02 per call, $0.0004 when the result is empty. Get a page of the accounts an X user follows, up to 200 a page.

Get an X user's profile by handle or ID: name, bio, follower and following counts, verification; up to 100 IDs in one request.

- [X community profile](https://dataxapi.com/apis/x/communities/get.md) `GET /v1/x/communities/get` $0.0004 per call, nothing when it finds nothing. Get an X community by its ID: name, description, members, moderators, how people join, when it was created.

Get accounts that follow an X list, by the list's ID, up to 20: handle, name, bio, follower count, verification. This page only, with no further page.

Get a page of the accounts an X list is made of, by the list's ID, 20 a page: handle, name, bio, follower count, verification.

## Facebook

- [Facebook page profile](https://dataxapi.com/apis/facebook/pages/get.md) `GET /v1/facebook/pages/get` $0.002 per call, nothing when it finds nothing. Get a public Facebook page by handle, ID or link: name, intro, follower count, likes, category, website, creation date.
- [Facebook page posts](https://dataxapi.com/apis/facebook/pages/posts/list.md) `GET /v1/facebook/pages/posts/list` $0.002 per call, also when the result is empty. Get a page of the posts a Facebook page published, by page ID, handle or link: text, time, reaction count, comment count, images; shares and views come from the post capability. Three posts a page, with older pages behind a cursor.
- [Facebook post comments](https://dataxapi.com/apis/facebook/posts/comments/list.md) `GET /v1/facebook/posts/comments/list` $0.002 per call, also when the result is empty. Get a page of the comments on a Facebook post or reel by the post's ID: text, commenter, reactions, reply count, time posted.
- [Facebook post detail](https://dataxapi.com/apis/facebook/posts/get.md) `GET /v1/facebook/posts/get` $0.002 per call, nothing when it finds nothing. Get one Facebook post or reel by its link: text, author, time, reaction count, comment count, shares, views, images.

## Google Ads

- [Google ad detail](https://dataxapi.com/apis/google/ads/get.md) `GET /v1/google/ads/get` $0.002 per call, nothing when it finds nothing. Get one ad of the Google Ads Transparency Center by its ID or link: format, headline, description, landing page, images and videos, when it was first and last shown, the countries or regions it was shown in, and the range of total impressions where the center publishes it.
- [Google advertiser's ads](https://dataxapi.com/apis/google/advertisers/ads/list.md) `GET /v1/google/advertisers/ads/list` $0.002 per call, also when the result is empty. Get an advertiser's ads from the Google Ads Transparency Center, by the advertiser's ID: format (text, image, video), when each was first and last shown, and a picture of it; can be limited to a country and to one format. 40 ads a page; what an ad says and where it leads come from the Google ad capability.
- [Google advertiser search](https://dataxapi.com/apis/google/advertisers/search.md) `GET /v1/google/advertisers/search` $0.002 per call, also when the result is empty. Find advertisers in the Google Ads Transparency Center by name: ID, name, the country or region they are registered in, and the center's estimate of how many ads they have. The ID is what the advertiser's ads are asked for by.

## LinkedIn

- [LinkedIn ad detail](https://dataxapi.com/apis/linkedin/ads/get.md) `GET /v1/linkedin/ads/get` $0.002 per call, nothing when it finds nothing. Get one ad of the LinkedIn Ad Library by its ID or link: advertiser, text, headline, images and videos, landing page, first and last day shown, bracket of impressions, the languages and locations targeted.
- [LinkedIn Ad Library search](https://dataxapi.com/apis/linkedin/ads/search.md) `GET /v1/linkedin/ads/search` $0.002 per call, also when the result is empty. Search the ads of the LinkedIn Ad Library by keyword: advertiser, text, headline, images and videos, landing page, first and last day shown, bracket of impressions, the languages and locations targeted; can be limited to a country.
- [LinkedIn company page](https://dataxapi.com/apis/linkedin/companies/get.md) `GET /v1/linkedin/companies/get` $0.002 per call, nothing when it finds nothing. Get a LinkedIn company page by handle or link: name, description, employee count, industry, size, kind of company, headquarters, website.
- [LinkedIn company posts](https://dataxapi.com/apis/linkedin/companies/posts/list.md) `GET /v1/linkedin/companies/posts/list` $0.002 per call, also when the result is empty. Get the latest posts a LinkedIn company page shows publicly (up to 10), by handle or link: ID, link, text, time. No author and no counts, which the post capability gives; this page only, with no older page.
- [LinkedIn post detail](https://dataxapi.com/apis/linkedin/posts/get.md) `GET /v1/linkedin/posts/get` $0.002 per call, nothing when it finds nothing. Get one LinkedIn post by its activity ID or link: text, author, time, reaction count, comment count, images.
- [LinkedIn post search](https://dataxapi.com/apis/linkedin/posts/search.md) `GET /v1/linkedin/posts/search` $0.002 per call, nothing when it finds nothing. Find public LinkedIn posts by search terms: text, author, time, reaction count, comment count; can be limited to a recent period. Results come from a web search engine's index of LinkedIn, not LinkedIn's own search, and are not complete.
- [LinkedIn video transcript](https://dataxapi.com/apis/linkedin/posts/transcript/get.md) `GET /v1/linkedin/posts/transcript/get` $0.002 per call, nothing when it finds nothing. Get what is said in the video of a LinkedIn post by its activity ID or link, as one text. Only where LinkedIn itself publishes a transcript with the video; most videos have none.

## Meta Ad Library

- [Meta ad detail](https://dataxapi.com/apis/meta/ads/get.md) `GET /v1/meta/ads/get` $0.002 per call, nothing when it finds nothing. Get one ad of the Meta Ad Library by its library ID or link: advertiser, text, headline, images and videos, landing page, first and last day shown, the platforms it is delivered on, and whether it is still running.
- [Meta Ad Library search](https://dataxapi.com/apis/meta/ads/search.md) `GET /v1/meta/ads/search` $0.002 per call, also when the result is empty. Search the ads running now in the Meta Ad Library (Facebook, Instagram and Meta's other apps) by keyword: advertiser, text, headline, images and videos, landing page, first and last day shown; can be limited to a country and to image or video ads, sorted by impressions or newest first. 30 ads a page.
- [Meta ad video transcript](https://dataxapi.com/apis/meta/ads/transcript/get.md) `GET /v1/meta/ads/transcript/get` $0.002 per call, nothing when it finds nothing. Get what is said in the video of a Meta Ad Library ad by its library ID or link, as one text.
- [Meta advertiser's ads](https://dataxapi.com/apis/meta/advertisers/ads/list.md) `GET /v1/meta/advertisers/ads/list` $0.002 per call, also when the result is empty. Get the ads an advertiser (a Facebook page) is running now in the Meta Ad Library, by the page's ID: text, headline, images and videos, landing page, first and last day shown; can be limited to a country and to image or video ads, sorted by impressions or newest first. 30 ads a page.
- [Meta advertiser search](https://dataxapi.com/apis/meta/advertisers/search.md) `GET /v1/meta/advertisers/search` $0.002 per call, also when the result is empty. Find advertisers (Facebook pages) in the Meta Ad Library by name: ID, name, picture, category, page likes, the linked Instagram account. The ID is what the advertiser's ads are asked for by.

## Threads

- [Threads post detail](https://dataxapi.com/apis/threads/posts/get.md) `GET /v1/threads/posts/get` $0.002 per call, nothing when it finds nothing. Get one Threads post by its code or link: text, author, time, likes, replies, reposts, images.
- [Threads post search](https://dataxapi.com/apis/threads/posts/search.md) `GET /v1/threads/posts/search` $0.002 per call, also when the result is empty. Find Threads posts by search terms: text, author, time, likes, replies, reposts; can be limited by publication date. One page of results.
- [Threads user profile](https://dataxapi.com/apis/threads/users/get.md) `GET /v1/threads/users/get` $0.002 per call, nothing when it finds nothing. Get a Threads user's profile by handle: name, bio, follower count, verification, avatar.
- [Threads user posts](https://dataxapi.com/apis/threads/users/posts/list.md) `GET /v1/threads/users/posts/list` $0.002 per call, also when the result is empty. Get a Threads user's latest posts by handle: text, time, likes, replies, reposts, images. The most recent page only; there is no older page.

## Instagram

- [Instagram comment replies](https://dataxapi.com/apis/instagram/comments/replies/list.md) `GET /v1/instagram/comments/replies/list` $0.002 per call, also when the result is empty. Get a page of the replies to an Instagram comment, by the comment's ID and its post's shortcode: text, replier, time posted.
- [Instagram hashtag posts](https://dataxapi.com/apis/instagram/hashtags/posts/list.md) `GET /v1/instagram/hashtags/posts/list` $0.002 per call, also when the result is empty. Get a page of the newest Instagram posts under a hashtag, by its name, about 33 a page: caption, author's ID, like and comment counts, time posted, image.
- [Instagram post comments](https://dataxapi.com/apis/instagram/posts/comments/list.md) `GET /v1/instagram/posts/comments/list` $0.002 per call, also when the result is empty. Get a page of comments on an Instagram post or reel by shortcode or link, about 15 a page, newest first: text, commenter, likes, time posted.
- [Instagram post detail](https://dataxapi.com/apis/instagram/posts/get.md) `GET /v1/instagram/posts/get` $0.002 per call, nothing when it finds nothing. Get one Instagram post or reel by shortcode or link: caption, author, like, comment and play counts, image and video addresses.
- [Instagram video transcript](https://dataxapi.com/apis/instagram/posts/transcript/get.md) `GET /v1/instagram/posts/transcript/get` $0.002 per call, nothing when it finds nothing. Get what is said in an Instagram reel or video post by shortcode or link, as one text; videos up to two minutes long.
- [Instagram user profile](https://dataxapi.com/apis/instagram/users/get.md) `GET /v1/instagram/users/get` $0.002 per call, nothing when it finds nothing. Get an Instagram user's profile by handle: name, bio, follower and following counts, verification, whether it is private.
- [Instagram user posts](https://dataxapi.com/apis/instagram/users/posts/list.md) `GET /v1/instagram/users/posts/list` $0.002 per call, also when the result is empty. Get a page of what an Instagram user posted, by handle, 12 a page, or its reels only: caption, like, comment and play counts, time posted, image and video addresses.
- [Instagram user search](https://dataxapi.com/apis/instagram/users/search.md) `GET /v1/instagram/users/search` $0.004 per call, also when the result is empty. Search Instagram accounts by keyword, about 50 in one answer and no further pages: handle, name, avatar, verification, whether it is private.

## TikTok

- [TikTok Ads Library search](https://dataxapi.com/apis/tiktok/ads/search.md) `GET /v1/tiktok/ads/search` $0.002 per call, also when the result is empty. Search TikTok's public Ads Library (ads shown in Europe) by keyword: advertiser, headline, videos and images, when each was first and last shown, and a bracket of people reached; newest first, 12 ads a page. This is the transparency record of ads, a different set from the Creative Center's Top Ads.
- [TikTok Ads Library ad detail](https://dataxapi.com/apis/tiktok/ads/get.md) `GET /v1/tiktok/ads/get` $0.002 per call, nothing when it finds nothing. Get one ad of TikTok's public Ads Library by its ID or link: advertiser, headline, videos and images, landing page, when it was first and last shown, the countries it was shown in and the campaign's objective.
- [TikTok comment replies](https://dataxapi.com/apis/tiktok/comments/replies/list.md) `GET /v1/tiktok/comments/replies/list` $0.002 per call, also when the result is empty. Get a page of the replies to a TikTok comment, by the comment's ID and its video's ID, 20 a page: text, replier, likes, time posted, which reply it answers.
- [TikTok Creative Center Top Ad detail](https://dataxapi.com/apis/tiktok/creative_center/ads/get.md) `GET /v1/tiktok/creative_center/ads/get` $0.002 per call, nothing when it finds nothing. Get one Top Ad of TikTok's Creative Center by its ID: the ad's video, caption, brand name, landing page, likes, comments, shares, length, campaign objective and the countries it ran in.
- [TikTok Creative Center Top Ads search](https://dataxapi.com/apis/tiktok/creative_center/ads/search.md) `GET /v1/tiktok/creative_center/ads/search` $0.002 per call, also when the result is empty. Search the Top Ads of TikTok's Creative Center by keyword: the ad's video, caption, brand name, likes, length and campaign objective; one country at a time, over a chosen period, in the Creative Center's own order or by likes. 20 ads a page. This is a showcase of ads that did well, not an ad library: it has no dates.
- [TikTok hashtag videos](https://dataxapi.com/apis/tiktok/hashtags/videos/list.md) `GET /v1/tiktok/hashtags/videos/list` $0.002 per call, also when the result is empty. Get a page of the TikTok videos under a hashtag, by its name, about 20 a page: caption, author, engagement counts, cover and play address.
- [TikTok user profile](https://dataxapi.com/apis/tiktok/users/get.md) `GET /v1/tiktok/users/get` $0.002 per call, nothing when it finds nothing. Get a TikTok user's profile by handle or ID: name, bio, follower, following and video counts, likes received, verification.
- [TikTok user search](https://dataxapi.com/apis/tiktok/users/search.md) `GET /v1/tiktok/users/search` $0.002 per call, also when the result is empty. Search TikTok accounts by keyword, 30 a page: handle, name, follower, following and video counts, likes received.
- [TikTok user videos](https://dataxapi.com/apis/tiktok/users/videos/list.md) `GET /v1/tiktok/users/videos/list` $0.002 per call, also when the result is empty. Get a page of the videos a TikTok user posted, by handle, 10 a page: caption, engagement counts, time posted, cover and play address; newest or most popular first.
- [TikTok video comments](https://dataxapi.com/apis/tiktok/videos/comments/list.md) `GET /v1/tiktok/videos/comments/list` $0.002 per call, also when the result is empty. Get a page of comments on a TikTok video by ID or link, 50 a page: text, commenter, likes, reply count, time posted.
- [TikTok video detail](https://dataxapi.com/apis/tiktok/videos/get.md) `GET /v1/tiktok/videos/get` $0.002 per call, nothing when it finds nothing. Get one TikTok video by ID or link: caption, author, like, comment, share, favorite and play counts, cover and play address.
- [TikTok video search](https://dataxapi.com/apis/tiktok/videos/search.md) `GET /v1/tiktok/videos/search` $0.002 per call, also when the result is empty. Search TikTok videos by keyword, 30 a page; sort by relevance, likes or time posted, and limit how recently they were posted.
- [TikTok video transcript](https://dataxapi.com/apis/tiktok/videos/transcript/get.md) `GET /v1/tiktok/videos/transcript/get` $0.002 per call, nothing when it finds nothing. Get what is said in a TikTok video by ID or link: the whole text and timed segments.
- [TikTok Shop product detail](https://dataxapi.com/apis/tiktok/shop/products/get.md) `GET /v1/tiktok/shop/products/get` $0.002 per call, nothing when it finds nothing. Get a TikTok Shop product in the United States by its ID: title, description, pictures, rating, reviews, units sold, shop; its price comes from the product search.
- [TikTok Shop product reviews](https://dataxapi.com/apis/tiktok/shop/products/reviews/list.md) `GET /v1/tiktok/shop/products/reviews/list` $0.002 per call, also when the result is empty. Get the first 10 buyers' reviews of a TikTok Shop product in the United States by the product's ID: text, rating, time, variant bought, pictures.
- [TikTok Shop product search](https://dataxapi.com/apis/tiktok/shop/products/search.md) `GET /v1/tiktok/shop/products/search` $0.002 per call, also when the result is empty. Search the products of TikTok Shop in the United States by terms: title, current and original price, rating, units sold, shop.
- [TikTok Shop seller products](https://dataxapi.com/apis/tiktok/shop/sellers/products/list.md) `GET /v1/tiktok/shop/sellers/products/list` $0.002 per call, also when the result is empty. Get a page of the products a TikTok Shop seller in the United States has on sale by the seller's ID: title, current and original price, rating, reviews, units sold.
- [TikTok user followers](https://dataxapi.com/apis/tiktok/users/followers/list.md) `GET /v1/tiktok/users/followers/list` $0.002 per call, also when the result is empty. Get a page of the accounts following a TikTok user, by handle, 50 a page, newest followers first: handle, name, bio, follower, following and video counts, likes received.

## Weibo

- [Weibo comment replies](https://dataxapi.com/apis/weibo/comments/replies/list.md) `GET /v1/weibo/comments/replies/list` $0.002 per call, also when the result is empty. Get a page of replies to a Weibo comment by comment ID: text, replier, likes, what it answers, time posted, IP location.
- [Weibo post comments](https://dataxapi.com/apis/weibo/posts/comments/list.md) `GET /v1/weibo/posts/comments/list` $0.002 per call, also when the result is empty. Get a page of comments on a Weibo post by post ID: text, commenter, likes, reply count, time posted, IP location.
- [Weibo post detail](https://dataxapi.com/apis/weibo/posts/get.md) `GET /v1/weibo/posts/get` $0.002 per call, nothing when it finds nothing. Get one Weibo post by ID: the whole text (of a long post too), author, likes, comments, reposts, reads, pictures, topics.
- [Weibo post likers](https://dataxapi.com/apis/weibo/posts/likers/list.md) `GET /v1/weibo/posts/likers/list` $0.002 per call, also when the result is empty. Get the accounts that most recently liked a Weibo post by post ID, about 50 at a time: name, bio, avatar, verification, follower and following counts, number of posts.
- [Weibo realtime search](https://dataxapi.com/apis/weibo/posts/search.md) `GET /v1/weibo/posts/search` $0.002 per call, also when the result is empty. Get a page of Weibo posts for search terms, newest first: text (a long post is cut short here), author and follower count, likes, comments, reposts, pictures, topics.
- [Weibo hot search board](https://dataxapi.com/apis/weibo/trends/list.md) `GET /v1/weibo/trends/list` $0.002 per call, also when the result is empty. Get Weibo's current hot search list, 50 terms, with rank and heat.
- [Weibo user followers](https://dataxapi.com/apis/weibo/users/followers/list.md) `GET /v1/weibo/users/followers/list` $0.002 per call, also when the result is empty. Get a page of the accounts following a Weibo user, 20 a page: name, bio, avatar, verification, follower and following counts, number of posts, when the account was opened.
- [Weibo user profile](https://dataxapi.com/apis/weibo/users/get.md) `GET /v1/weibo/users/get` $0.002 per call, nothing when it finds nothing. Get a Weibo user's profile by user ID: name, bio, avatar, verification, follower and following counts, number of posts.
- [Weibo user posts](https://dataxapi.com/apis/weibo/users/posts/list.md) `GET /v1/weibo/users/posts/list` $0.002 per call, also when the result is empty. Get a page of the posts on a Weibo user's profile (their own and their reposts) by user ID, newest first: text (a long post is cut short here), likes, comments, reposts, pictures, topics, whether pinned.
- [Weibo user search](https://dataxapi.com/apis/weibo/users/search.md) `GET /v1/weibo/users/search` $0.002 per call, also when the result is empty. Get a page of Weibo users for search terms: ID, name, avatar, profile link.

## Xiaohongshu (RedNote)

- [Xiaohongshu image search](https://dataxapi.com/apis/xiaohongshu/images/search.md) `GET /v1/xiaohongshu/images/search` $0.02 per call, also when the result is empty. Search Xiaohongshu pictures by terms, a page at a time; each result is one picture with the note it belongs to: the picture's address, the note's title, text, author, likes, comments, saves and shares.
- [Xiaohongshu note detail](https://dataxapi.com/apis/xiaohongshu/notes/get.md) `GET /v1/xiaohongshu/notes/get` $0.02 per call, nothing when it finds nothing. Get one Xiaohongshu note by ID or link: title, text, author, engagement counts, images.
- [Xiaohongshu comment replies](https://dataxapi.com/apis/xiaohongshu/comments/replies/list.md) `GET /v1/xiaohongshu/comments/replies/list` $0.02 per call, also when the result is empty. Get a page of replies to a Xiaohongshu comment, by the comment's ID and its note's ID: text, replier, likes, time posted, which comment it answers.
- [Xiaohongshu note comments](https://dataxapi.com/apis/xiaohongshu/notes/comments/list.md) `GET /v1/xiaohongshu/notes/comments/list` $0.02 per call, also when the result is empty. Get a page of top-level comments on a Xiaohongshu note by ID or link, newest first: text, commenter, likes, reply count, time posted.
- [Xiaohongshu note search](https://dataxapi.com/apis/xiaohongshu/notes/search.md) `GET /v1/xiaohongshu/notes/search` $0.02 per call, also when the result is empty. Search Xiaohongshu notes by terms: title, text, author, engagement counts, images, and a link that opens.
- [Xiaohongshu PGY keyword search index](https://dataxapi.com/apis/xiaohongshu/pgy/keywords/history.md) `GET /v1/xiaohongshu/pgy/keywords/history` $0.04 per call, nothing when it finds nothing. Get a keyword's day-by-day search index on Xiaohongshu over about the last three months, from the platform's creator marketplace, with each day's notes about the keyword and how often they were shown, read and engaged with. The platform sets the period; it cannot be chosen. The search index is the platform's index, not a count of searches; days are calendar days in China time (UTC+8).
- [Xiaohongshu PGY related keywords](https://dataxapi.com/apis/xiaohongshu/pgy/keywords/related.md) `GET /v1/xiaohongshu/pgy/keywords/related` $0.04 per call, also when the result is empty. Get what people search on Xiaohongshu before and after a keyword, from the platform's creator marketplace, each with its place by relevance, its search index, the notes about it and their reads: for expanding a seed keyword. The search index is the platform's index, not a count of searches; for a word the platform gives no figures for, these are null.
- [Xiaohongshu topic notes](https://dataxapi.com/apis/xiaohongshu/topics/notes/list.md) `GET /v1/xiaohongshu/topics/notes/list` $0.02 per call, also when the result is empty. Get the trending notes under a Xiaohongshu topic by its page ID: title, text, author, engagement counts, images, hashtags.
- [Xiaohongshu topic detail](https://dataxapi.com/apis/xiaohongshu/topics/get.md) `GET /v1/xiaohongshu/topics/get` $0.02 per call, nothing when it finds nothing. Get one Xiaohongshu topic by its page ID: name, description, views, the discussion count the page shows, share link.
- [Xiaohongshu trends](https://dataxapi.com/apis/xiaohongshu/trends/list.md) `GET /v1/xiaohongshu/trends/list` $0.02 per call, also when the result is empty. Get the hot topics Xiaohongshu suggests to creators: name and the platform's heat score.
- [Xiaohongshu user profile](https://dataxapi.com/apis/xiaohongshu/users/get.md) `GET /v1/xiaohongshu/users/get` $0.02 per call, nothing when it finds nothing. Get a Xiaohongshu account by user ID or profile link: name, handle, bio, follower, following and note counts, verification.
- [Xiaohongshu user notes](https://dataxapi.com/apis/xiaohongshu/users/notes/list.md) `GET /v1/xiaohongshu/users/notes/list` $0.02 per call, also when the result is empty. Get a page of the notes a Xiaohongshu account posted, by user ID or profile link: title, text, engagement counts, images, whether pinned.
- [Xiaohongshu user search](https://dataxapi.com/apis/xiaohongshu/users/search.md) `GET /v1/xiaohongshu/users/search` $0.02 per call, also when the result is empty. Search Xiaohongshu accounts by terms: user ID, handle, name, avatar, verification.
- [Xiaohongshu product detail](https://dataxapi.com/apis/xiaohongshu/shop/products/get.md) `GET /v1/xiaohongshu/shop/products/get` $0.02 per call, nothing when it finds nothing. Get a product of Xiaohongshu's shop by its ID: title, current and original price in yuan, pictures, rating, reviews, shop.
- [Xiaohongshu product reviews](https://dataxapi.com/apis/xiaohongshu/shop/products/reviews/list.md) `GET /v1/xiaohongshu/shop/products/reviews/list` $0.02 per call, also when the result is empty. Get the first page of buyers' reviews of a product of Xiaohongshu's shop by the product's ID: text, rating, variant bought, pictures, likes.
- [Xiaohongshu product search](https://dataxapi.com/apis/xiaohongshu/shop/products/search.md) `GET /v1/xiaohongshu/shop/products/search` $0.02 per call, also when the result is empty. Search the products of Xiaohongshu's shop by terms: title, current and original price in yuan, units sold, picture, shop.
- [Xiaohongshu PGY creator search](https://dataxapi.com/apis/xiaohongshu/pgy/creators/search.md) `GET /v1/xiaohongshu/pgy/creators/search` $0.04 per call, also when the result is empty. Search Xiaohongshu creators on PGY by terms, matched against what they write about: creator ID, name, handle, location, content categories, followers, and in the full view what an image note and a video note cost and median reads and interactions. The creator ID the other PGY endpoints take comes from here.
- [Xiaohongshu PGY creator detail](https://dataxapi.com/apis/xiaohongshu/pgy/creators/get.md) `GET /v1/xiaohongshu/pgy/creators/get` $0.04 per call, nothing when it finds nothing. Get a Xiaohongshu creator's profile on PGY by creator ID: name, handle, location, content categories, followers, and in the full view what an image note and a video note cost, the number of sponsored notes and median reads and interactions.
- [Xiaohongshu PGY creator audience profile](https://dataxapi.com/apis/xiaohongshu/pgy/creators/audience/get.md) `GET /v1/xiaohongshu/pgy/creators/audience/get` $0.04 per call, nothing when it finds nothing. Get who follows a Xiaohongshu creator, by PGY creator ID: the share of each segment by gender, age, province, city, interest and device, and the day the figures are of.
- [Xiaohongshu PGY creator metrics](https://dataxapi.com/apis/xiaohongshu/pgy/creators/metrics.md) `GET /v1/xiaohongshu/pgy/creators/metrics` $0.04 per call, nothing when it finds nothing. Get how a Xiaohongshu creator's everyday notes did over the last 30 or 90 days, by PGY creator ID: notes, median impressions, reads and interactions, engagement and completion ratios, the share of notes past 100 and 1,000 likes, and the standing among comparable creators.
- [Xiaohongshu PGY creator notes](https://dataxapi.com/apis/xiaohongshu/pgy/creators/notes/list.md) `GET /v1/xiaohongshu/pgy/creators/notes/list` $0.04 per call, also when the result is empty. Get a page of a Xiaohongshu creator's notes by PGY creator ID, newest first, with the figures PGY gives for each: reads, likes, saves, whether it was sponsored and for which brand.

- [WeChat Channels account collections](https://dataxapi.com/apis/wechat_channels/users/collections/list.md) `GET /v1/wechat_channels/users/collections/list` $0.02 per call, also when the result is empty. Get every public collection of a WeChat Channels account by the account's ID: name, description, cover, number of videos, when it was last updated. A collection's ID is what the endpoint that lists its videos takes.

Get a page of WeChat Channels videos for search terms through WeChat Search, by relevance, newest or hottest, filtered by time posted: description, the account's name and avatar, time published, likes and saves, length, cover. WeChat Search gives no account ID, and a video's ID is the encrypted one of the search result, which the Channels video endpoint does not take.

## WeChat Search

WeChat Search gives no account ID.
